sentences.en: Although this aphrodisiacal effect of red may be a product of societal conditioning alone, the authors argue that men's response to red more likely stems from deeper biological roots.

sentences.en: Ancient South American civilisations prized them so much for their medicinal and aphrodisiacal properties, they even used them as currency.

sentences.en: Rats infected with Toxoplasma actually like cat odors. New research finds that the infection makes cat odor aphrodisiacal. Steve Mirsky reports.
sentences.vi: Chuột bị nhiễm Toxoplasma thực sự thích mùi hôi của mèo. Nghiên cứu mới phát hiện ra rằng nhiễm trùng làm cho mèo có mùi kích thích tình dục. Steve Mirsky báo cáo.
